traits.text: Pale to medium grey fertile discs within minute dark apothecia, emerging through the epidermis of overwintered fallen leaves

traits.label: Body
traits.text: Tiny cup- to disc-shaped apothecia, initially immersed, later erumpent; asexual stage forming small greyish acervuli within dark brown, circular to irregular leaf spots, often surrounded by yellowing tissue
traits.raw: ℹ️ Body: Tiny cup- to disc-shaped apothecia, initially immersed, later erumpent; asexual stage forming small greyish acervuli within dark brown, circular to irregular leaf spots, often surrounded by yellowing tissue

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Parasitic on living leaves of Ribes species; causes anthracnose, leaf spotting and premature defoliation; overwinters saprobically on fallen leaves; airborne ascospores in spring, rain-splashed conidia during summer to autumn
traits.raw: 🍁🍂 Parasitic on living leaves of Ribes species; causes anthracnose, leaf spotting and premature defoliation; overwinters saprobically on fallen leaves; airborne ascospores in spring, rain-splashed conidia during summer to autumn

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Microscopic; infected leaf spots usually ~1–2 mm across, sometimes merging into larger necrotic patches
traits.raw: 📏 Microscopic; infected leaf spots usually ~1–2 mm across, sometimes merging into larger necrotic patches

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Ascospores ellipsoid to ovoid, smooth, hyaline, aseptate, ~16–22 × 7–9.5 µm; asci clavate, 4–8-spored, ~65–105 × 18–21 µm, with iodine-blue apical ring; paraphyses filiform, slightly enlarged apically; macroconidia falcate, aseptate, ~17.5–24 × 5.5–7 µm; microconidia cylindrical, ~4–6.5 × 2–3 µm
